title: Small deformations x ↦ x + tZ(x) are injective immersions (parent step 2)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let Z : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C¹ with compact support. There is c > 0 such that for every real t with |t| < c the map Φ_t(x) := x + tZ(x) is injective on ℝ^P and its derivative DΦ_t(x) (fderiv) is injective at every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 Z → HasCompactSupport Z → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t| < c → Injective (fun x => x + t • Z x) ∧ ∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ (fun x => x + t • Z x) x)
